title: Sea-ice area trend · Barents, Greenland, Kara seas
source: NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4.0, regional monthly
method: Monthly ice area (km^2) per sea-ice region as published by NSIDC. Trends are ordinary least squares on the monthly series and are quoted per decade; era comparison contrasts 1979-2000 with 2007-latest. Nothing is smoothed, gap-filled or extrapolated.

provenance.honesty: Figures are read straight from the NSIDC workbook; ORBIT only computes the fits and anomalies.
